Zara: tiny announcement — promoted to Design Lead (pinches) and also getting married next month! would love a small courtyard hang next Thu 4pm if people can make it. no pressure, just snacks + a quick toast.
Priya: WOW huge congrats on both!!! absolutely 4pm works for me. any registry or playlist recs for the party? :tada:
Zara: thank you!! registry is optional: https://babylist.com/zara-wedding (link). playlist recs welcome f3b6
Ben: congrats zara!! i can bring savory snacks and take care of disposable plates/napkins.
Sam: will there be cake? if yes i'm in. also can we add a 10-min remote call link in case folks are remote?
Zara: cake yes please. Sam if you can add a short video join link that would be awesome.
Kelly: :confetti_ball: congrats!! i can do a banner and a tiny speech (1 min) if that helps.
Marco: :thumbsup: i'll bring sparkling water + mocktails. also happy to coordinate gift contributions if folks want (opt-in).
pyro-bot: Event proposed: "Zara: promo + wedding hang" Thu 4:00 PM 8 Courtyard. React with :thumbsup: to RSVP.
Priya: short RSVP form: https://forms.gle/zara-cc (3 questions). i'll add a field for dietary needs.
Ben: non-dairy + nut-free snacks from me.
Sam: remote link added to calendar invite: zoom.us/j/999888 (placeholder).
Zara: you all are the best. tiny ask: if anyone has a quick silly gif for a toast, drop it here and i'll collage them.
Marco: dropping a ridiculous confetti GIF now :confetti_ball:
Kelly: see you all next Thu f382
